items.briefing:
Scammers are increasingly targeting Australians through fake gambling and betting websites, so staff should be cautious about unsolicited messages promoting betting opportunities. Separately, a phishing service is actively impersonating RingCentral to trick users into handing over their Microsoft 365 login credentials — if your organisation uses either platform, be especially sceptical of unexpected login prompts or emails asking you to verify your account. Phishing attacks involving fake device login codes have also surged dramatically this year, meaning phone-based scam calls attempting to steal account access are becoming more common.

If you receive an unexpected email or call asking you to log in or approve access to any work account, stop and verify the request directly with your IT team before taking any action.
